close_reason: Extracted role_already_held(role_str, all_mailboxes, vacated, exclude_id) helper. Create loop passes None for exclude_id; update loop passes Some(&id). Eliminates duplicate iter().any() predicate across both loops.
description: mailbox.rs handle_mailbox_set: the role uniqueness check appears independently in the create loop (~line 462) and the update loop (~line 663), with the same pattern: check all_mailboxes, check roles_just_created/claimed, check roles_actually_vacated. Suggest extracting a fn is_role_taken(role_str, all_mailboxes, vacated, created_map, claimed_set) -> bool so the logic is in one place and changes to the algorithm (e.g., adding cross-request deduplication) only need updating once.
title: Role uniqueness logic is duplicated across create and update loops
